title: Buy CAPIT | Connect Wallet and Review Contract Details
description: Review wallet requirements, network details, contract information, fees, and transaction steps before you interact with the CAPIT protocol.
headline: Buy CAPIT
body: CAPIT is accessed through a self-custody wallet flow exclusively on the Base network. Review the network, contract details, expected fees, and strict risk disclosures before you proceed.

sections.heading: Before You Connect
sections.body: Make sure your wallet supports the Base network, that you understand how token swaps work, and that you are ready to review the transaction in your wallet before signing. You do not need a wallet to browse CAPIT’s environmental data dashboard. You only need one if you choose to connect or interact with the protocol.

sections.heading: Review the Contract Details
sections.body: Before any handoff to a swap interface, CAPIT displays the following details in plain text for total transparency.
bullets: Source repository: [Insert Repository URL or ‘Not yet published’]
Disclosure version: [Insert Date or Version ID]

sections.heading: Security Reminder
sections.body: CAPIT will never ask for your secret recovery phrase, private keys, or wallet password. If any page, prompt, or support message asks for them, stop immediately.

sections.heading: Transaction Flow
sections.body: Connect your wallet, confirm the Base network, review approvals, review the swap, submit the transaction, wait for confirmation, then view success or failure details. CAPIT cannot recover wallets or reverse blockchain transactions.

sections.heading: Error Messages
sections.body: Wallet missing: Wallet not found. Unsupported network: Switch to Base. Insufficient balance: Insufficient balance for the selected amount and network cost. User rejected: Transaction rejected in your wallet. Swap failed: Review details and try again.
